newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerian top trade unionist badly wounded in attack.
newsitem.headline: Algerian top trade unionist badly wounded in attack.

text.p: Algeria's top trade union leader Abdelhak Benhamouda was seriously wounded in an attack on Tuesday afternoon in central Algiers, Algerian security forces said.
In a statement on the official news agency APS, the security forces said Benhamouda was attacked in May 1st Square in central Algiers.
"The victim was immediately evacuated to Mustapha hospital where his condition was judged serious," the security forces said.
